items.name: Southwest of F.A.N.G Center
items.location: House by a small body of water southwest of F.A.N.G Center
items.guide: Eliminate enemies outside to the left of the house. Enter the house; the card is on a shelf above the couch.

items.name: North West of Cedar Lake
items.location: Lakeside house northwest of Cedar Lake
items.guide: Clear the enemies on the lakeside of the building. Head inside to find the card on the chest of drawers next to the bed.

items.name: West of Cedar Lake
items.location: Mountain cabin west of Cedar Lake
items.guide: Access via grapple or flying vehicle. Clear enemies and enter through the front door; the card is immediately behind the opening door on a desk.

items.name: North of Whitetail Park Visitor Center
items.location: Shack in the hills north of Whitetail Park Visitor Center
items.guide: Enter the enemy-free shack and turn left. The card sits on a shelf.

items.name: South West of Clagett Boathouse
items.location: Petrol station on the road southwest of Clagett Boathouse
items.guide: Enter the petrol station building. The card is on a shelf underneath the 'Clothing' sign.

items.name: Cooper Cabin
items.location: Cabin northeast of the Wolf's Den
items.guide: Head inside to the room with a mattress propped up against the wall. The card is on the shelf straight ahead.

items.name: F.A.N.G Center
items.location: F.A.N.G Center gift shop
items.guide: Liberate or clear the cultists. Enter the building to the right of the main entrance; the card is on a merchandise shelf in the center of the gift shop.

items.name: McNeil Residence
items.location: Northeast of F.A.N.G Center along the road
items.guide: Clear the cultists and enter the white shed to the left. The card is on a shelf on the wall behind the door.

items.name: North East of Baron Lumber Mill
items.location: White shipping-container style house on race tracks behind Baron Lumber Mill
items.guide: Clear nearby enemies, kick down the boarded-up door, and take the card off the wall as you enter.

comic_books.quest_giver_location: Dodd Residence (between Fall's End and Rae-Rae's Pumpkin Farm), Holland Valley

items.name: Parker Laboratories
items.location: West of Fall's End
items.guide: Go up the stairs inside the house with the green roof. The comic book is directly ahead on the desk.

items.name: Boyd Residence
items.location: Directly west of the Dodd Residence
items.guide: Enter the house, turn left into the bedroom, and find the comic book on the bed next to a hunting bow.

items.name: Bradbury Farm
items.location: South of Lamb of God Church, below crop circle
items.guide: Enter the large barn to the right. Jump up to the second level via boxes in front of the blue tarp; the comic is on an old mattress.

items.name: Jefferson Lookout Tower
items.location: Mountain peak west of the Wolf's Den
items.guide: Go to the cliffside entrance and ascend the stairs into the tower. The comic sits on a table right inside the entrance.

items.name: McNeil Residence
items.location: On the road between F.A.N.G Center and Fort Drubman
items.guide: Break the boarded-up window around the back of the house. Enter into the second room, turn left into the bathroom, and grab the comic from the basin.

items.name: Elliot Residence
items.location: South of F.A.N.G Center
items.guide: Climb onto the verandah where the barbed wire is broken and enter through the broken window. The comic is on cases next to a lamp.

items.name: Peaches Taxidermy
items.location: Peaches Taxidermy workshop grounds
items.guide: Enter the grey house through the white door on the left side of the property. The comic is located right next to the television.

items.name: Chan Residence
items.location: Just south of Angel's Peak
items.guide: Go around the back of the house, enter through the blue door, and find the comic on a bed directly behind the door.

items.name: Vasquez Residence
items.location: Waterfront between Faith's region and Dutch's Island
items.guide: Dispatch the cultists outside, enter through the front door, and grab the comic from the living room couch.

items.name: O'Hara's Haunted House
items.location: Border of Faith and John's regions, northwest of Dead Man's River
items.guide: Climb the crate with blue ropes behind the house onto the roof, drop to the scaffolding, and crouch through the second-floor window. The comic is on a mattress.

items.name: Boshaw Manor
items.location: Southwest of Moonflower Trailer Park
items.guide: Walk up the ramp into the house marked with 'No Smoking' signs. Go to the rear bedroom; the comic is on the bedside table.

items.name: Camp Cougars
items.location: Campsite southeast of Peaches Taxidermy
items.guide: Clear cultists/predators at the campsite. The comic is lying on the ground directly in front of one of the tents.

items.name: Baron Lumber Mill
items.location: Baron Lumber Mill main building
items.guide: Ascend the front stairs and enter through the window. The bobblehead is straight ahead in the kitchen.

items.name: Whitetail Park Ranger Station
items.location: Southwest of F.A.N.G Center
items.guide: Enter the main office, go behind the front desk into the adjacent room, and grab the bobblehead from the chest of drawers on the left wall.

items.name: Island North of Grand View Hotel
items.location: Small island cabin north of Grand View Hotel
items.guide: Swim north to the island log cabin. The bobblehead is located inside on a splash of blood on the bed.

items.name: Lansdowne Airstrip
items.location: Hangar north of F.A.N.G Center (Inside 'Hangar Pains' Prepper Stash)
items.guide: Grapple the nearby radio tower, wingsuit/parachute onto the hangar roof, drop through the open skylight, and find the bobblehead on a shelf.

items.name: Whitetail Park Visitor Center
items.location: Visitor Center gift shop
items.guide: Head up the stairs and turn left into the souvenir shop. The bobblehead sits directly in front on a merchandise display shelf.

items.name: South Park Entrance
items.location: Border of Jacob's and John's regions, north of Rae-Rae's Pumpkin Farm
items.guide: Ascend the wooden stairs behind the buildings. The bobblehead is on the floor mixed with discarded junk.

items.name: St. Isidore School
items.location: Abandoned school northeast of Fall's End
items.guide: Climb onto the main school roof to retrieve the keys from the chimney. Zipline to the outbuilding, unlock it, and pick the bobblehead up from the shelf.

items.name: Bradbury Tractor Shed
items.location: North of the crop circle between Fall's End and Lamb of God Church
items.guide: Approach the small building next to the shed, break the wooden slats covering the window, and retrieve the bobblehead inside the broken refrigerator.

items.name: 8-Bit Pizza Bar
items.location: West of Hope County Jail
items.guide: Walk through the front door, pass behind the service counter into the kitchen, and grab the bobblehead off the shelf next to the dishware.

items.name: Feeney Residence
items.location: Eastern outskirts of Henbane River
items.guide: Clear the cultists in the field and enter the house. The bobblehead is on the kitchen counter against the wall.

vietnam_lighters.quest_giver_location: Redler Residence, East of Fall's End

items.name: West of Cedar Lake
items.location: Underground bunker west of Cedar Lake
items.guide: Climb down into the bunker and grab the lighter off the shelf next to two blue barrels.

items.name: North West of Widow's Creek
items.location: Bunker off the main road northwest of Widow's Creek
items.guide: Enter the roadside bunker and retrieve the lighter located in the back room next to the television.

items.name: Whitetail Park Visitor Center
items.location: Visitor Center information building
items.guide: Climb the stairs and turn left into the information center. The lighter is on a set of shelves in the second room to the left.

items.name: Elliot Residence
items.location: Bunker at Elliot Residence (South of F.A.N.G Center)
items.guide: Enter the upper story via the broken window, navigate down to the kitchen for the keycard, shoot the bunker lock in the shed outside, and find the lighter on the bench.

items.name: Fillmore Residence
items.location: East of Fall's End, west of Dead Man's River
items.guide: Enter the antler-adorned shed and descend into the bunker. The lighter sits on shelves in the second room.

items.name: Miller Residence
items.location: Southwest of Fillmore Residence
items.guide: Head to the white shed and drop down into the bunker hatch. The lighter is on the floor beside the nightstand.

items.name: Harris Residence
items.location: Northwest Holland Valley
items.guide: Enter the bunker via the hatch inside the brown wooden shed. The lighter is on the shelves beside the bed.

items.name: Rae-Rae's Pumpkin Farm
items.location: North of Fall's End
items.guide: Find the bunker hatch out in the open behind the farm buildings. The lighter is on a chair beside the bed.

items.name: McCoy Cabin
items.location: West of Peaches Taxidermy
items.guide: Locate the bunker hatch partially covered by green tarp. The lighter is on the shelving unit in the second room.

items.name: McClean Residence
items.location: Border between Faith's region and Dutch's Island
items.guide: Clear any hostile cultists and access the bunker near the rear of the property. The lighter is on the bed in the rear room.

items.name: Abercrombie Residence
items.location: East of Hope County Jail
items.guide: Go behind the main house to find the bunker entrance before the stairs. The lighter is on shelves in the second room.

items.name: Counselor's Cabin
items.location: West and slightly south of Moonflower Trailer Park
items.guide: Walk between the house and shed to reach the backyard bunker hatch. The lighter is in the second room on the shelf near the couch.

items.name: Osprey Cabin
items.location: Directly south of Wolf's Den down the cliff
items.guide: Enter through the side door of the log cabin. The crate sits on the coffee table between the sofa and television.

items.name: Dansky Cabin
items.location: South of Wolf's Den between two roads
items.guide: Approach the front door with the keypad lock; the vinyl crate is located outside under a table to the left of the door.

items.name: Hunter's Pass Shelter
items.location: Northwest of Wolf's Den
items.guide: Clear the area around the small brick cabin and head inside. The crate is on a table immediately past the door.

items.name: Red Tail Cabin
items.location: Directly east of Wolf's Den
items.guide: Enter the large wooden house and turn left into the kitchen. The crate rests on the counter beside the window.

items.name: Breakthrough Camp
items.location: East of Red Tail Cabin
items.guide: Pass through the main camp gate and turn right to the first lock house. The crate is on a shelf along the entryway wall.

items.name: North Park Entrance
items.location: Road heading west from F.A.N.G Center
items.guide: Go inside the southern building. The vinyl crate is sitting on top of a low bookshelf.

items.name: The Grill Steak
items.location: Outdoor restaurant south of F.A.N.G Center
items.guide: Walk past the barbecue grill and truck toward the gazebo shelter. The crate is in front of a tent underneath.

items.name: MCA Mobile Lab
items.location: East of Baron Lumber Mill
items.guide: Dispatch any wolves roaming the perimeter. The crate is sitting directly under the open grey canopy tent.

items.name: Linero Building Supplies
items.location: North of Baron Lumber Mill, west of Fort Drubman
items.guide: Proceed to the construction trailer at the back of the site, enter the blue door, and retrieve the crate on a desk behind a filing cabinet.

items.name: South Park Entrance
items.location: Border road between Wolf's Den and Rae-Rae's Pumpkin Farm
items.guide: Enter the roadside office next to the ACROD parking spot. The crate is on the floor in front of tipped filing cabinets.

whiskey_barrels.quest_giver_location: Can of Worms Fishing Store, Silver Lake, Henbane River

items.name: East of Can of Worms Fishing Store
items.location: Silver Lake shallows east of the fishing store
items.guide: Swim out from the shore and dive into the lake bed; the barrel sits in reeds beside a submerged log.

items.name: West of Drubman Marina
items.location: Silver Lake waters west of Drubman Marina
items.guide: Dive underwater between a large boulder and a fallen log to retrieve the barrel.

items.name: Silver Lake Campgrounds
items.location: Just north off the shoreline of Silver Lake Campgrounds
items.guide: Dive down next to a large rock and a floating Bliss barrel.

items.name: Tanami Residence
items.location: Island offshore from Tanami Residence
items.guide: Locate the metal shipping container suspended from a crane over the water; swim inside the open end to find the barrel at the bottom.

items.name: West of Tanami Residence
items.location: Lake inlet halfway toward the northern bridge
items.guide: Dive into a small underwater rocky cavern along the lake bed to locate the barrel.

items.name: East of Oberlin Picnic Area
items.location: Silver Lake inlet south of two small islands
items.guide: Submerge into another small rocky underwater alcove marked on the map.

items.name: South of Oberlin Picnic Area
items.location: Coastal rocky outcropping on an island south of Oberlin Picnic Area
items.guide: The barrel is on top of tall rocks above water. Grapple to Adelaide's helicopter or fly up to drop onto the high rock ledge.

items.name: Clagett Bay
items.location: Under the lake surface below the large island in Clagett Bay
items.guide: Dive down to locate a sunken helicopter; the barrel is resting inside the wreckage.

items.name: Forest Research Station
items.location: Off the coast of Dutch's Island near the Forest Research Station
items.guide: Dive beneath the water surface and retrieve the barrel pinned under a pile of submerged timber.

items.name: West of Silver Lake Boathouse
items.location: Open water halfway between Dutch's Island and Holland shore
items.guide: Dive straight down roughly 150m southwest of the research station to find the barrel on the lake floor.

items.name: South of Central Radio Tower
items.location: Under the southern bridge near Dutch's Island border
items.guide: Locate the submerged cage near a large rock formation; swim around the open side to collect the barrel.

items.name: North of Dutch's Island
items.location: Lake waters north of Dutch's Island above two islets
items.guide: Dive through murky water to search the sunken debris field where the barrel is lodged.

items.name: North of Vasquez Residence
items.location: Under the bridge north of Vasquez Residence
items.guide: Enter the large metal pipe opening from the land side and swim through to retrieve the barrel at the end of the line.

items.name: South of Tanami Residence
items.location: Channel between islands south of Tanami Residence
items.guide: Dive down and enter the mouth of an underwater drainage culvert to collect the barrel.

items.name: West of Can of Worms Fishing Store
items.location: Bridge canal west of Can of Worms Fishing Store
items.guide: Locate the fully submerged shipping container among the wrecks, swim inside, and make an immediate left-then-right turn to grab the final barrel.

holland_valley.name: Deep Dive
holland_valley.location: Laurel Residence, west of Rye & Son's Aviation
holland_valley.guide: Read the kitchen note. Drop into the flooded backyard bunker, swim to the far desk for the shed keycard, use the yellow pump switch inside the shed to drain the water, and smash the boards in the bunker.

holland_valley.name: D.I.Y. and D.O.A.
holland_valley.location: Doverspike Compound, northwest end of Holland Valley
holland_valley.guide: Grab the shed key from the back bedroom dresser. Unlock the shed, climb down into the bunker, navigate to the back closet to switch on the generator, and carefully return to the keycard door avoiding traps.

holland_valley.name: Dumpster Diving
holland_valley.location: Waste Treatment Facility north of Fall's End
holland_valley.guide: Shoot the explosive barrel to clear roof debris. Grapple across the yard, enter the flooded basement, activate the north wall breaker, and parkour across shelving and beams to avoid the electrified water.

holland_valley.name: Fire in the Hole
holland_valley.location: Cabin above Orville Creek, southeast Holland Valley
holland_valley.guide: Clear the cultists and smash through the cabin floorboards. Descend into the Bliss-filled mine, eliminate the addicts, and blow up the rubble blocking the water channel to raise the pool level and cross to the stash.

holland_valley.name: Foxhole
holland_valley.location: Grace Armstrong's house, east of Lamb of God Church
holland_valley.guide: Climb through the open window, survive the boiler blast, climb through the collapsed second story onto the burned roofline, cross the gap, and drop into the hidden bunker hatch.

holland_valley.name: High Tension
holland_valley.guide: Ride the series of ziplines connecting lookout platforms down the mountainside, timing your transitions between lines, until you zip directly into the silo containing the stash.

holland_valley.name: Long-Distance Lockpick
holland_valley.location: Reservoir dock north of Fall's End
holland_valley.guide: Eliminate the cultist across the water. Zipline to the sniper perch, grab the scoped rifle, shoot the yellow padlock visible through the boathouse window across the reservoir, and swim back to collect the loot.

holland_valley.name: Man Cave
holland_valley.location: Sunrise Threshing, east of Fall's End
holland_valley.guide: Reverse the pickup truck to climb over the fenced yard. Shoot the gate lock from the inside, hitch the truck to the trailer blocking the hatch, move it, and enter the underground bunker into the locked garage.

holland_valley.name: Playing With Fire
holland_valley.guide: Enter the large drainpipe leading south to the pond. Follow the blood trail out the other end, defeat the cultist and bear to recover the key from the corpse, return to the pipe, kill the wolverine, and unlock the gate.

holland_valley.name: Swingers
holland_valley.location: Bridge of Tears, east of Rae-Rae's Pumpkin Farm
holland_valley.guide: Drop to the scaffolding beneath the bridge and chain grapple swings across the underside supports to reach the central suspended platform. Smash the wooden floorboards to drop onto the cache.

holland_valley.name: Vespiary
holland_valley.guide: Climb onto the roof via the animal cage and enter through the window. Carefully climb the ledges inside the elevator tower while avoiding or burning the wasp nests to reach the stash on top.

henbane_river.name: Animal Control
henbane_river.location: Howling Cave, north of Peaches Taxidermy
henbane_river.guide: Clear the wolves and cultists at the cave entrance. Grapple upward through the cave network, navigate the narrow crawling pass, eliminate the inner squad, and grapple to the high platform with the stash and escape chopper.

henbane_river.name: Dead Man's Treasure
henbane_river.location: Cabin north of Sharky's Trailer Park
henbane_river.guide: Crawl beneath the cabin foundation to enter through the floor and pick up the gearwheel. Zipline to the waterfall floodgate, turn the wheel to stop the torrent, rappel down into the cave entrance behind the falls.

henbane_river.name: Getaway
henbane_river.location: Gas station east of Hope County Jail
henbane_river.guide: Break into the garage around back, release the car handbrake on the lift, hit the door switch, kill the wolverine in the back stalls, take the key above the toilet, and unlock the stash room inside the shop.

henbane_river.name: O'Hara's Haunted House
henbane_river.location: Haunted house near the rail bridge, Henbane/Holland border
henbane_river.guide: Climb onto the house roof via the rear crate and scaffolding. Enter the attic window and flip the power lever. Slide down the zipline, enter the front door of the funhouse, walk through the exhibit, and climb to the loft.

henbane_river.name: Overwatch
henbane_river.location: Raptor Peak, north of Rock Bass Lake
henbane_river.guide: Grapple and mantle up the sheer rock faces of Raptor Peak while fighting off predatory eagles. Reach the summit campsite and assist or bypass the pinned Resistance squad to loot the stash.

henbane_river.name: Pooper Scooper
henbane_river.location: Silver Lake Summer Camp, northwest of Peaches Taxidermy
henbane_river.guide: Scaffold through the upper window of the main red building. Interact with the dog scat piles across the rooms until you recover the swallowed master key, then unlock Cabin 2 outside.

henbane_river.name: Side Effects
henbane_river.location: Abandoned Radon Spa, southeast of Hope County Jail
henbane_river.guide: Enter the mine tunnel past sleeping Angels. Reach the rear chamber to start the generator, which powers the stash door at the front. Fight through the newly awakened Angels on your backtrack to claim the loot.

henbane_river.name: The Angels' Grave
henbane_river.location: Cave south of Rock Bass Lake
henbane_river.guide: Eliminate cultists discarding corpses into the open pit and rappel down. Carefully platform across rock pillars and ziplines to avoid the boiling acidic geothermal water below, then defeat the final guards.

whitetail_mountains.name: Cliffhanger
whitetail_mountains.location: Crashed truck beneath western mountain bridge
whitetail_mountains.guide: Read Ted's note at the crashed truck. Follow the blood trail and grapple up the waterfall cliff, take down the patrol near the bridge to retrieve Ted's key, and parachute back down to unlock the lockbox.

whitetail_mountains.name: Gone Squatchin'
whitetail_mountains.location: Dansky Cabin, northwest of Langford Lake
whitetail_mountains.guide: Follow the trail from the cabin up to the destroyed lookout platform. Grapple across the cliff crags to the bone-littered cave ledge, retrieve the keycard beside Dansky's corpse, and return to unlock the cabin.

whitetail_mountains.name: Hangar Pains
whitetail_mountains.location: Lansdowne Airstrip, north of F.A.N.G Center
whitetail_mountains.guide: Grapple to the peak of the radio tower south of the airstrip. Wingsuit and parachute directly through the open roof skylight, drop inside, and hit the wall button to open the hangar doors.

whitetail_mountains.name: Mayday
whitetail_mountains.location: Footbridge in the far northwest mountains
whitetail_mountains.guide: Cross the footbridge and follow the plane crash debris up the canyon. Grapple across rock faces and collapsed spans, eliminate the three scavengers at the summit, take the key from the crate, and open the lockbox at the crash base.

whitetail_mountains.name: Salvage Rites
whitetail_mountains.location: Small island off the southern end of Clagett Bay
whitetail_mountains.guide: Swim out from the campsite following the red marker buoys and guideline underwater. Dive down to the sunken aircraft fuselage, grab the keycard next to the pilot, and swim back to unlock the island chest.

whitetail_mountains.name: Shipwreck
whitetail_mountains.location: Island west of the railway bridge (Henbane border)
whitetail_mountains.guide: Swim into the submerged dredge through an open hull window. Climb to the wheelhouse, activate the dredge lever to break open the bunker ceiling, swim through the flooded tunnel, and watch out for the snake inside.

whitetail_mountains.name: The Holdouts
whitetail_mountains.location: Elliot Residence, south of F.A.N.G Center
whitetail_mountains.guide: Climb onto the second-story roof via the broken porch. Walk through the upper rooms, take the stairs down to find Richard Elliot's keycard, eliminate cultist reinforcements, and shoot the padlock off the backyard shed bunker hatch.

whitetail_mountains.name: Unwelcome Guest
whitetail_mountains.location: Cabin on the western mountain border (Whitetail/Holland)
whitetail_mountains.guide: Read Hardcastle's door note and follow the trail of dropped supplies westward into the mountain cave. Slay the grizzly bear ('Not-So-Gentle Ben'), search Hardcastle's remains for the key, and unlock the cabin door.
